title: oedera longipes
intro: Oedera longipes, commonly known as the "Wild Basil" or "Bush Basil", is a shrub-like plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal and culinary properties, and is known to offer several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Oedera longipes include its use as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, which can help to soothe and calm various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oedera longipes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
